Definition: middle voice from G4012 and G4160; to make around oneself, i.e. acquire (buy):--purchase.
BiblicalUsage: Peripoieomai means to acquire, to purchase, to make one's own. Jesus says whoever seeks to save his life shall lose it, and whoever loses it shall preserve it. Paul tells the elders to feed the church of God, which He hath purchased with His own blood, and deacons who serve well purchase a good degree and great boldness in the faith.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the church was bought, not built by men: God purchased it with His own blood, and that is the price of every soul in it. I hold that the purchase runs both ways — whoever loses his life preserves it, and whoever serves well gains boldness. My life is not my own; it was bought, and I live it for the Buyer.
